Q02.answer: molly:chat and interactive molly:setup --agent=amp need a TTY and the Amp binary. molly:preflight and molly:install-model measure macOS facts and record them unknown on other operating systems. They do not need a Bloom process. molly:start runs in PHP. Queued execution needs a queue worker. Local Orbs are local workers. Hosted Orbs are not shipped.
Q02.unknown: Whether a future native host must own model installation is unknown. The current installer is Artisan plus the local Ollama API.

Q03.answer: molly:approve, molly:lock-test, molly:pr-opened, molly:merged, molly:comment, and molly:handoff require --approve and change nothing without it. MCP refuses those six with HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED. molly:install-model requires a terminal prompt or --approve. QueueTask adds no second start or retry job while one is queued or running. LocalAgentBus::refuseUnclaimable() allows start only from pending and retry only from failed or stopped, and refuses a completed idempotency key with COMMAND_ALREADY_SUCCEEDED.
